title: Hardware/software co-design of a VNA control pipeline
summary: Design and prototype a modular control and data-acquisition pipeline for the Wavision VNA platform.
prerequisites: Digital design, Python or C/C++, basic FPGA knowledge.
outcomes: Working prototype, documented architecture, measurements, thesis report.

title: High-Level Synthesis exploration for custom accelerators
summary: Study HLS design-space exploration techniques for compute kernels and compare architectural choices.
prerequisites: C/C++, computer architecture, interest in digital implementation.
outcomes: Reusable HLS experiments, benchmark results, design guidelines.

title: System-level modeling of SoC communication and memory effects
summary: Build executable models to evaluate communication, buffering, and memory organization before RTL implementation.
prerequisites: Computer architecture, C/C++ or Python, basic embedded systems.
outcomes: Modeling framework, case studies, architectural analysis.

title: RTL prototyping and verification of a configurable digital block
summary: Design, implement, and verify a reusable RTL block for a larger experimental platform.
prerequisites: Digital systems, HDL basics, willingness to learn verification practices.
outcomes: RTL module, tests, synthesis results, integration notes.
